section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section highlights that loneliness and gratitude are negatively correlated, suggesting gratitude may moderate loneliness. It also notes gender differences, with women potentially more vulnerable to loneliness, and that single individuals report higher loneliness than married/cohabiting ones. The section concludes by outlining several limitations of this study, including the use of a non-random convenience sample of internet users, potential self-selection bias, low generalizability due to a small number of male respondents, and the correlational nature of the research preventing causal conclusions.
